mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) over the next 60 trading days signals a flattening yield curve, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index over the next 20 trading days signals accelerating price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to raise policy rates, compressing discount rates and reducing equity present value, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS employment growth over the next 60 trading days signals a strengthening labor market, prompting higher wage growth and consumer demand, which increases equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly PAYEMS employment growth over the next 20 trading days signals a weakening labor market, prompting lower wage growth and consumer demand, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly INDPRO supply growth over the next 60 trading days signals a late-cycle supply shock, reducing future earnings growth and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in supply-shock periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly INDPRO supply growth over the next 60 trading days signals a supply expansion that boosts future earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly HOUST retail sales over the next 20 trading days signals stronger consumer demand, prompting higher equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly HOUST retail sales over the next 20 trading days signals weak consumer demand, prompting lower equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
